notes.title: Game Update to 1.15!
notes.notes:
A NEWEST UPDATE FOR THE GAME A WEEK OF CIRCUS TERROR (1.15 version).

MAIN NEWS

 Difficulty Update for Charley the Clown, Cheesy and one "secret" toy.
 The jammed doors mechanism is newly upgraded (now 3 levels and the chance is more higher to be stuck in the room - Especially harder from night 10 and higher.
 The Grandfather clock is more adapted to your situation. If you are under attack of some antagonist; and now it can not be abused by you.
 "The Tiger" antagonist has various problem of not get him away from you (this happens in night 7+). Now it's fixed.
 A lot better game endings than the last updates. I had to add some better sounds and more smooth continuity of scenes.

MINOR NEWS
 
 Czech texts are now 100% correctly edited. 
 Little problem with language transitions in intro cutscenes. 

From graphic there is no so mush interesting update. Mainly some bugs are fixed and for some game elements there are better upgrades for better game experince. Also enjoy your the Christmas time and have a nice day (play)!

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
A NEWEST UPDATE FOR THE GAME A WEEK OF CIRCUS TERROR (1.10).

MAIN NEWS

    Halloween Update! A new halloween decoration in rooms.
    A new game mechanism of jammed doors. (mechanism with two levels)
    Difficulty in nights is changed (for better game experience)
    Some new sounds + main music is edited.
 

MINOR NEWS

    Some minor bugs are fixed (Like texts in czech language, some bugs with sounds)
 

Halloween brings some graphic decorations and animations in rooms - also some new sounds. The jammed doors mechanism is ramdomly generated, it will choose one door in the house, which will not be possible to open. Also it is chance to have jammed door, but to open it you have to push it enough. First levels (nights) are more easier than in the last versions.

THAT'S ALL.
HAVE A NICE PLAY!

notes.title: Game Update 1.05
notes.notes:
A NEWEST UPDATE FOR THE GAME A WEEK OF CIRCUS TERROR (1.05 version).

MAIN NEWS

   Broken Continue button after beating the seven night (effecting not to continue in the game for another 7 nights..) FIXED!
   New Language added! In the beginning you have choice between English or Czech language (translated texts and subtitles).
   Help in form of hint! This hint will help to understand the mechanism between one main antagonist (how to win against Cheesy)
   One jumpscare animation is updated.
   Some new cutscenes.

MINOR NEWS

   A lot of minor bugs are fixed. (Achievements, score, texts, jumpscare animations...)
   Easier difficulty for the first levels and the last nights.

THAT'S ALL.
HAVE A NICE PLAY!

notes.title: What's new in full version? 1.0
notes.notes:
Of course this available demo version has only 7 nights, full version has everything. More nights, more story, new mechanisms and bonuses.
But there are some new minor improvements between antagonists.

* Charley the Clown and Cheesy has theirs limit of "must appear in a room".
* Tiger will appear to kill you if you don't reactivate the generator for some time.
* Cheesy has new sounds of running and looking for you, and also the door handle sound.
* Cheesy contains a new way to kill you, try not to find it.

Also small minor bugs fixed, like the clown from the attic, but main bugs added in main game Guide in section POSSIBLE BUG WARNING are almost non-fixeable for me..

(Cheesy = the dog/bear toy.
Charley the Clown = a small clown toy.)

So have a nice play, I hope you will like this game a little bit. Don't forget, this is my first official made game ever. Sorry for my English. 

(and for some people, this game has nothing to do with FNAF universe, but some similar mechanism or ideas of toys are truly inspired)
